assets.prompt:
Create ONE original finished landscape 4:3 illustration for the Secret Circle party game app. The attached town-square Mafia illustration is the exact STYLE REFERENCE: match its clearly animated polished 3D characters, expressive eyes and eyebrows, adult cartoon acting, believable but stylized clothing, colorful shaped environments, strong staging and soft directional lighting. Keep the same degree of detail as this reference, not a flat toon-shader version, not live-action photorealism and not baby-like cute mascots. Design original characters only. The illustration must explain the game through character action, facial expression, outfit and location. Main faces and decisive gesture clustered in the central 60% of the image for small tile and banner crops. Use a DIFFERENT location, palette and story than the reference. No words, letters, numbers, logos, brands, watermarks, phones, UI, real people, existing franchise characters, alcohol, cups, weapons or violence.

WORD IMPOSTER: A lean emerald-green anthropomorphic chameleon in a fitted plum-purple casual blazer and charcoal mock-neck shirt is seated in a stylish small indoor game lounge with rounded art-deco wall panels and muted emerald-green upholstery, warm brass accent lighting. Medium close-up framing, expressive face in center. The chameleon is confidently improvising a spoken clue, half-lidded eyes glance sideways, one brow raised and an asymmetrical smirk hides uncertainty. It holds ONE clearly BLANK ivory card at upper chest height toward the viewer; free hand makes a restrained conversational gesture. From each frame edge one other cartoon player's hand holds an ivory card with the SAME single gold KEY pictogram on both, showing that the other players know the same secret and our chameleon does not. The two edge cards flank the face, not cover it. Two arms and clean distinct hands on the chameleon. Animated stylized scales as broad simple shapes, not realistic reptile skin. Character face, blank card and matching edge clues readable in a small game tile. Coral and brass warm accent colors against a muted deep green lounge. No detective gadgets, no repeated moonlit village, no added crowd. This is a funny bluffing social game scene.

TRUTH OR DARE: A playful little theater rehearsal stage with burgundy curtains and warm amber footlights, a restrained dark-indigo backdrop, no writing. TWO ORIGINAL adult cartoon characters illustrate both choices in one shared moment. Left, an adult human theater magician with an angular expressive face, short dark sculpted hair, fitted midnight-blue waistcoat over an ivory shirt, bow tie loosened, sleeves rolled neatly, is admitting an embarrassing truth: one hand over the heart, other hand has just lowered a small plain theatrical half-mask away from the face. Honest sheepish grin, one brow raised, a restrained blush; face visible and unmasked. The removed mask represents dropping the pretence and revealing the truth. Right, an original athletic copper-orange raccoon stunt performer with dark eye markings and a fitted teal stage jumpsuit with reinforced elbows is performing a controlled one-hand handstand on the stage, free hand stretches for balance and legs bend into a funny confident silhouette. Its expression is a mischievous determined grin looking toward the magician. Exactly two arms and two legs on each character, coherent grips and separate limbs, both figures fully understandable and no duplicate hands. Truth side is calm and candid, dare side bold and energetic. The two faces close enough to be visible centrally at thumbnail scale, slightly larger upper bodies, no tiny distant characters. Keep lively adult animation humor and appropriate role-specific outfits, no ordinary stock people, no question-mark cards or repeated detective archetype. Warm burgundy and amber with crisp teal costume accent. A believable stylized stage scene in exactly the same animation world as the Mafia reference.

assets.prompt:
An original finished 4:3 landscape illustration for a playful social deduction party game, titled Mafia in the app (do not write the title in the image). A fully animated, stylish 3D cartoon scene with strongly simplified sculpted geometry, smooth matte color surfaces, appealing expressive adult cartoon characters, clean readable silhouettes and restrained stage lighting. Same animation universe as the reference chameleon, with far simpler surfaces: all fur and hair made from broad solid sculpted shapes. Visibly animated, cool and witty, suitable for a party game for friends.

A compact cartoon town square at night with chunky curved cobblestones, two simplified crooked navy-blue houses, big warm amber windows, a rounded streetlamp and a simple moon disk. A slim original gray cat in a fitted ink-blue suit and charcoal fedora is secretly whispering to a stocky original weasel in a mustard waistcoat and rolled-sleeve shirt, behind a low rounded brick corner. The cat cups one paw near its mouth, checks the surroundings with a raised brow and intelligent sideways glance. The weasel has a very funny overconfident innocent smile and tense shoulders, pretending nothing is happening. Behind the far side of the corner, an original adult human woman detective with short sculpted swept hair and a dark teal trench coat peeks with a skeptical knowing expression; she has noticed their hidden alliance. Clothes, expressions and gestures clearly suit each role. Strong specific action and funny theatrical staging rather than posed portraits. Main cat/weasel pair large near center, detective smaller on the right, three anatomically coherent figures with clearly separate hands.

Rich violet-blue night palette, mustard and burgundy accents, warm stylized lamplight illuminating faces. Broad graphic background shapes and simple toon shadows, plenty of color even at night. Balanced adult cartoon proportions, expressive smaller eyes, confident character design. Flat large material shapes, smooth sculpted coat and hair masses, no tiny surface detail, no photographic skin or realistic animal rendering. No text, labels, logos, cards, interface or watermark. Original fictional designs only. One unified lively image, readable as a small game tile.
